title: Ambient breathing glow
summary: A slow loop (3.5–5s) gently pulsing opacity and scale on a glow behind the thing that matters: the hero object, or the plan you want chosen.
use_when: Drawing attention to one thing without moving it.
avoid_when: More than one glow per screen.
specimen_html:
The plan you want chosen
4.2s ease-in-out · infinite

evidence.measured: @keyframes launchBagGlowBreath { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.22; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1.03); } }
